== Card credits ==
Matt Jourdan is credited with the original concept of one Players Committee [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The concept credit names where the concept was won: 10th Anniversary Design Contest. The card is in [[Virtual Block 8]] (released 2012–2013).

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Released !! Credit as printed
|-
| [[Assassin's Blaster Rifle|••Assassin's Blaster Rifle]] || [[Virtual Block 8]] || 2012–2013 || "Original concept by Seth Acree & Matt Jourdan, 10th Anniversary Design Contest"
|}

The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Matt Jourdan|Matt Jourdan]] on [[Card Credits]].
